source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Unsupervised Machine Learning' under topic 6.4 (PDF 80, printed 76).

blocks.text: Unsupervised machine learning unlabeled data ke saath kaam karti hai. System baghair rehnumai ke khud patterns dhoondta hai. Yeh milte julte data ko ikattha kar ke clusters (groups) banata hai. Yeh chhupi hui structures (banawat) dhoondne mein mufeed hai. Koi sahi output nahi diya jata; seekhna is par munhasir hai ke data aapas mein kitna milta hai. Unsupervised learning data ka rawaiya samajhne aur data ko explore (khoj) karne mein madad deti hai. Misal: customers ki grouping aur data clustering.
